title: Allow API tests to issue local HTTP requests
summary: API tests can now issue local HTTP requests by declaring explicit test HTTP request policies, and OCR authentication header handling was corrected to avoid validation errors.
key_points: Adds AllowAllOutboundRequests policy annotation to 153 API test codeunits
Fixes OCR service authentication by using TryAddWithoutValidation for x-rs-key header
Resolves test failures caused by default BlockOutboundRequests policy
Preserves legacy HTTP request manager wire behavior for OCR mock service
No public API or schema changes
